notes.owner_notes: >Korra is a sweet, playful, energetic dog, approximately 35 pounds, who was rescued in February 2021. She had puppies in late 2020. She is eager to meet many dogs when on walks, but the leash seems to get in her way from being able to play as freely as she likes. She can bark while playing as well. We think she got pregnant from a very large male dog, so she can be nervous around large male dogs; if it is possible to take that into account it would be great. We are currently training with Irith Bloom (The Sophisticated Dog) and she along with Dr. Julie Cho at VCA West LA recommended your daycare as a great place to learn socialization skills and get playtime with other dogs in a caring and comfortable environment where she can build confidence. We are also working on separation anxiety and have made great progress recently - she will have a great time with playful and sweet humans to let her know she is loved!
852 11th street Santa Monica
